description: This file defines a configuration class 'XInferenceImageGenerationConfig' for image generation tasks tailored to the XInference service. It inherits from a base config class and provides methods to handle OpenAI-specific parameters for image generation models.

classes.name: XInferenceImageGenerationConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for image generation with XInference, extending BaseImageGenerationConfig and providing methods to manage OpenAI parameters.

methods.name: List[OpenAIImageGenerationOptionalParams] get_supported_openai_params( self, model: str )
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI image generation optional parameters for a given model.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps non-default and optional parameters, validating support for the specified model, and optionally drops unsupported parameters.
